Forty-two comments

Farewell to Whalley Range

This tune is off a Michael McGoldrick John McSherry Album “At First Light” and was originally transcribed by Devin McCabe. Thanks Devin, its a great tune. I play it in a set of Tar Road to Sligo/Give us a Drink of Water/Farewell to Whalley Range. Enjoy….

↳ Posted by kiwi on January 19th, 2004.

It was composed by Mike McGoldrick when he moved from Whalley Range, area of Manchester he used to live in. Also on capercaillie’s albulm ‘Nadurra’

↳ Posted by RacH on January 20th, 2004.

Key

This is actually in F# minor pentatonic, not A major - although I suppose you could supplement some very interesting chord progressions in A that might fit………

↳ Posted by jamminben on January 24th, 2004.

Key and concertina

Yeah you’re right but there’s no choice in the drop down menu for F# minor so I just went for the nearest key signature. I meant to make a note about that in the first comment. Thanks for reminding me….Any other concertina players tried this one yet? Its a beauty to twist the fingers around

Farewell To Whalley Range, X:6

This is a Bminor version taught to a recent whistle master class by Kevin Crawford. Mike McGoldrick’s tune is lovely, anyway, but in this key, it fairly sings! There are two options for the wrap-around, either BAB or BAE, both of which work fine.
